title: Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.16364v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly refutes the intuitive "crowded-harness / lost-in-the-middle" explanation: the failure is at the decision readout, not the harness, and we pin it there three ways. (1) Input vs. readout: repairing the prompt (reordering or duplicating the gold tool) recovers <=23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59-91%. translated_title: 看见并不等于选中：LLM智能体工具选择失败的注意力-片段解释
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体会错误地调用工具，一个自然的猜测是：模型在拥挤的工具列表中没能“看到”正确的工具。我们通过一个被同期研究所忽视的视角——模型对带有标签的工具定义片段的注意力——证明了事实恰恰相反。在真实的BFCL失败案例上，通过逐候选的注意力argmax分析，模型在80%的情况下最关注的正是正确的工具（相比之下随机水平为21%），而正确工具成为注意力最低片段的情况仅占10%：模型看着正确的工具，却仍然选错了。这直接反驳了直觉上的“工具列表拥挤/迷失在中间”解释：失败发生在决策读出环节，而非工具列表本身，我们通过三种方式将失败定位于此。(1) 输入 vs. 读出：修复提示词（重新排序或复制正确工具）只能恢复不超过23%的失败案例，而读出端的干预可恢复59-91%。(2) 表征不变性：两种指向正确工具但作用于不同表征的干预——一种加性注意力logit偏置……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 这篇论文通过对注意力片段的分析发现，LLM智能体在80%的工具调用失败中其实最关注的正是正确的工具，失败源于决策读出环节而非工具列表干扰——修复提示词只能挽回≤23%的失败，而读出端干预可挽回59-91%。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that LLM agents' tool-selection failures occur at the decision readout rather than in a crowded harness: the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time yet still picks wrong, and readout-side interventions recover 59–91% of failures versus ≤23% for input-side prompt repairs.
